mapper.update: UPDATE ums_member target_member JOIN ums_member inviter ON inviter.id = #{inviterId} AND inviter.status = 1 AND inviter.del_flag = 0 SET target_member.invite_user_id = CAST(#{inviterId} AS CHAR), target_member.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE target_member.id = #{memberId} AND target_member.status = 1 AND target_member.del_flag = 0 AND target_member.id != inviter.id AND (target_member.invite_user_id IS NULL OR TRIM(target_member.invite_user_id) = '')
